reason: The checked 72-byte legacy/v2 XChaCha wrap and 48-byte HPKE ciphertext authenticate to exactly 32 plaintext bytes; this conversion error requires an upstream size-contract defect.
RustCrypto XChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption only rejects inputs exceeding its counter bound; the prior 1 MiB bound is smaller. Allocation failure aborts rather than returning this error.
